title: Handwritten notes with sketches: apparatus, horizon line, and '50km to 150Km' box
description: Lined notepaper with pencil and ink notes and sketches: a small drawing of a bracket- or T-shaped structure at top with a handwritten label, a long horizontal line drawn across the page like a horizon, an oval box enclosing "50km to 150Km", and small hatched marks. Notes reference chemical mixtures (potassium perchlorate, barium nitrate, aluminum), "6 or 7 rockets", "NASA" and a meeting date of "June 1".
